purpose: Runs the scheduled backup job on a seeded folder and checks copies and archives; injects a known fault and checks the known fix runs, with the required yes, before any ticket is offered.
title: Nightly backup and self-fix first

testCases.description: lay-down writes the backup job's agent: the backup program every night at 02:30, never kept alive, and its load reaches no real launchd domain
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/backup.test.js::lay-down writes the backup job's agent: the backup program every night at 02:30, never kept alive, and its load reaches no real launchd domain

testCases.description: the backup copies an added file, and a file removed from the owner's folder stays in the backup
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/backup.test.js::the backup copies an added file, and a file removed from the owner's folder stays in the backup

testCases.description: a changed file's earlier copy moves to the dated archive, and nothing in the backup is ever overwritten or deleted
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/backup.test.js::a changed file's earlier copy moves to the dated archive, and nothing in the backup is ever overwritten or deleted

testCases.description: an absent backup destination gives no partial pass: the failure is recorded, the health check names the backup and the destination, and the next run succeeds
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/backup.test.js::an absent backup destination gives no partial pass: the failure is recorded, the health check names the backup and the destination, and the next run succeeds

testCases.description: a backup destination that cannot be written gives no partial pass: the failure is recorded, the health check names it, and the next run succeeds
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/backup.test.js::a backup destination that cannot be written gives no partial pass: the failure is recorded, the health check names it, and the next run succeeds

testCases.description: a full backup destination gives no partial pass: the failure is recorded, the health check names it, and the next run succeeds
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/backup.test.js::a full backup destination gives no partial pass: the failure is recorded, the health check names it, and the next run succeeds

testCases.description: a changed floor file is named and its fix asked for; after the owner's yes the session still cannot make it, and the scheduler's next run lays core down again from the release and the check finds it gone
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/known-fixes.test.js::a changed floor file is named and its fix asked for; after the owner's yes the session still cannot make it, and the scheduler's next run lays core down again from the release and the check finds it gone

testCases.description: the runner not running is named and its fix asked for; after the owner's yes the scheduler's next run reloads the agents, loads nothing outside the account's own home, and says plainly the fault is still there
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/known-fixes.test.js::the runner not running is named and its fix asked for; after the owner's yes the scheduler's next run reloads the agents, loads nothing outside the account's own home, and says plainly the fault is still there
